question: The compound interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 20% per annum is ₹864. Find the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate and period.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Rate of Simple Interest for 3 years at 20% = 20% × 3 = 60%.

Effective Rate of Compound Interest for 3 years at 20% = 3(20) + 3(20²)/100 + (20³)/10000 = 60 + 12 + 0.8 = 72.8%.

Given, the Compound Interest (72.8%) corresponds to ₹864.

Simple Interest (60%) = (864 ÷ 72.8) × 60 = 64800 ÷ 91 ≈ 712.087...

**∴ The correct answer is ₹712.09.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Compound Interest (CI) = ₹864

Rate (R) = 20% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

CI = P[(1 + R/100)T − 1]

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 Compound Interest Effective Rate: 72.8% Value: ₹864 Simple Interest Effective Rate: 60% Value: ? 
• 
 SI = (864 ÷ 72.8) × 60 ≈ ₹712.09 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 864 = P[(1 + 20/100)³ − 1]

⇒ 864 = P[(6/5)³ − 1]

⇒ 864 = P[216/125 − 1]

⇒ 864 = P[91/125]

⇒ P = (864 × 125) ÷ 91

Now, substitute the value of Principal (P) to calculate Simple Interest:

⇒ SI = (P × 20 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = P × (60 ÷ 100) = 3P/5

⇒ SI = 3/5 × [(864 × 125) ÷ 91]

⇒ SI = (3 × 864 × 25) ÷ 91

⇒ SI = 64800 ÷ 91 ≈ 712.0879...

**∴ The correct answer is ₹712.09.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 3 years at rate R%, effective rate = 3R + (3R²)/100 + (R³)/10000. Using effective rates helps in bypassing the principal to find relations between CI and SI faster.

Difference between CI and SI (2 Years)

The absolute difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years is given by the formula: D = P(R/100)².

Difference between CI and SI (3 Years)

The absolute difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 3 years is calculated directly as: D = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).
